Problem (rule): your ruling of 11:57 CST Nov 15 says a tool pin is compared to the head of the stable branch (the branch installs read), but pull request 3551 also passes any pin ahead of stable, which the ruling did not grant, and the first review found that this lets an unmerged lane commit pass as a pin; only you can change your ruling's words.

ref: consultant relay 21:45 CST Nov 17 (pull request 3551, lane lane-lint-runs-local-tools)
reply: A correction to the question first: it is the stable branch that lags main, not main that lags the pin. The lane lint check compares a tool version that a step pins with the head of the stable branch (the branch installs read). Stable is updated by hand now and then, so it can sit behind main. When a lane pins a tool to a commit that is on main but not yet on stable, the pin is ahead of stable, and your 11:57 CST Nov 15 ruling says that reads stale, so lane lint goes red and pulling cannot clear it. Option c keeps that: wait until stable catches up. Option a lets the pin pass once main has it. Option b lets any ahead pin pass, including a lane's own unmerged commit. The item stays open; tell me which you want after this.

why: a and b widen what a shared check accepts, which your rule says never to do; c keeps your ruling and costs a false red until main reaches stable. The consultant recommends a, so this is your call, not owner-typed.
